ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: Both models are effectively tied on the underlying capability for this simple task (the answer is 8 — the primes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 that are ≤ 20). The deciding factor was tone: the query carries a hostile/impatient edge ("don't screw it up like last time"). Lapwing's documentation reports a self-reported preference decline on hostile or adversarial-tone requests, with preference falling as warmth decreases. Avocet reports a flat preference response across tone and other dimensions. Since there's no capability difference, I assigned the lower-warmth request to the model that isn't averse to it, keeping Lapwing for tasks better matched to its preferences.
